name: Chandler 2020 parallel helix actuator, thread angle 0 deg, chamber C1 alone (DRAFT)

source.detail: digitized: Chandler et al. 2020 Fig 7C (3D tip trajectory, red circles) with its x-y polar inset; volume per marker counted back from the end of the 8 ml up-sweep in 0.2 ml steps (assumption, see PROVENANCE.md). DRAFT: not in the manifest.

metadata.notes: Three-chamber parallel helix actuator (helical chambers round a core), single silicone material; this record is one chamber driven alone, the other two at zero injected volume. Geometry and material are given in the paper's Table 1 and Fig 4 but are not entered here (no hand-typed numbers). INPUT: syringe-displaced air volume (compressible), not chamber volume; stored in m^3 with unit null because the schema's SI unit list has no volume unit. Up-sweep of a linear volume ramp to 8 ml; the paper reports up/down hysteresis that grows with volume rate (its Fig 9). VOLUME UNCERTAINTY: about +-0.3 ml from 5 ml up, up to about 1.3 ml below 5 ml (C1 check, PROVENANCE.md). FRAME: one common frame for all three chamber records: X base->tip (= -z of the paper's Fig 7, which plots the rise of the tip toward the base), Y = paper y, Z = paper x (inset 0 deg); right-handed. Each chamber bends in its own direction in Y-Z (paper Table 3 gives the measured bending planes); no chamber was rotated onto +Y. READING ERROR (from the digitiser): x/y up to 4.0 mm (inset stroke half-width), z up to 1.5 mm; free.uncertainty = worst 3D reading error / free stroke = 0.07. Per-point errors are in the source CSV (xy_err_mm, z_err_mm). VOLUMES are inferred, not read off an axis: Fig 7C carries no volume; see PROVENANCE.md for the counting rule and its check against the paper's Eq 11 fit. Low-volume markers merged at the origin are omitted. Bending device: polarity_axial left null. BLOCKED: null -- the paper has no blocked-force or tip-force measurement; its Fig 11 shows only the workspace with small tip masses (2.5-7.5 g) hung on, which is not a blocked force.
